directions.title: Your raise can buy less
directions.audienceProblem: Confusing a higher paycheck with improved purchasing power
directions.tensionHook: Your paycheck grew. So why can you buy less?
directions.promise: Explain nominal and real income with one worked example
directions.payoff: A 5% raise with 8% inflation means about 2.8% less purchasing power
directions.visualApproach: Pay slip, price-tagged basket, exact calculation and purchasing-power comparison
directions.musicMood: Light, inquisitive mallet groove with a clear resolving ending
risks: Label example hypothetical; use exact ratio, not subtraction
directions.productionComplexity: Native vector motion, low asset complexity

directions.audienceProblem: Confusing a higher paycheck with improved purchasing power
directions.tensionHook: What does your paycheck actually buy?
